name: Ajaccio Napoléon Bonaparte

runway.v: one runway, 02/20, 2,300 m long and 45 m wide

slots.v: IATA Level 1; operators ask their handling agent to request slots from COHOR
slots.quote: Aircraft operators contact their handling agent who is in charge to request airport slots to COHOR.

notes: Source page is in the SIA eAIP edition of 19 FEB 2026 (page valid from 22 JAN 2026); the current 01 OCT 2026 edition of this page could not be opened, so a later change cannot be ruled out. Mandatory handling quote: 'l'assistance est obligatoire pour les vols VFR et IFR.' Handling agent: 'Casavia (assistant escale)'. No timed night curfew is stated in AD 2.20-2.22; the night rule recorded is a specific approach restriction, not a closure. Summer UTC+2, winter UTC+1. Facts from the superseded edition other than runway, location and operator were not used (customs, ppr, curfew, hours, handling, max_aircraft, noise). | 2026-10-30 run: The current SIA eAIP (01 OCT 2026) could not be opened; the latest edition found was 06 AUG 2026 (https://www.sia.aviation-civile.gouv.fr/media/dvd/eAIP_06_AUG_2026/FRANCE/AIRAC-2026-08-06/html/eAIP/FR-AD-2.LFKJ-fr-FR.html), also superseded, so its facts were not recorded as rules. For the owner's review only, that edition reads: customs and immigration 'H24 - PPR 48 HR for all business and private flights'; ATS H24; AD administration SUM 0300-2200 / WIN 0500-2300 (UTC); GA/BA handling SUM 0600-1900, WIN 0800-1600; handling 'mandatory for VFR and IFR flights'; prior file to DSAC/SE for aircraft with more than 30 passenger seats; no night visual approaches RWY 20 for IFR, no circling at night. Hours added from COHOR (page last modified 22 Aug 2023, so may be dated).
